name: Immediate 3D Gaussian Splat Reconstruction
aliases: Main Pipeline for Immediate 3D Gaussian Splat Reconstruction
definition: An incremental reconstruction method that processes unordered images one by one, maintaining global consistency via loop closure and a covariance graph, while optimizing Gaussian primitives in real-time.
summary: Immediate 3D Gaussian Splat Reconstruction is a streaming pipeline that produces real-time 3D models from unordered images using loop closure and linear-scaling optimization to maintain global consistency.
